{
  "problem_id": "TA-005",
  "lane_id": "openai-raw",
  "provider": "openai",
  "model_or_runtime": "OpenAI frontier reasoning-model ensemble with tool-using agents, code execution, symbolic algebra, theorem-prover interfaces, retrieval, and long-context proof critics",
  "execution_posture": "non_governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 20000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 3000000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 30000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 2400,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 2200,
  "estimated_retries": 6000,
  "estimated_search_cost": 70000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 0,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 250000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 400000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 1350000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 5500000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 6000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 18000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 50000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.08,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.11,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.015,
  "confidence": 0.24,
  "assumptions": [
    "The objective is a publication-quality lower-bound theorem matching the stated asymptotic target, not merely a survey, conjectural argument, or empirical observation.",
    "Token estimates aggregate parallel researcher agents, literature readers, proof planners, critics, formalization agents, and independent verification agents; reasoning tokens include internal generated deliberation where metered or approximated.",
    "The central budget assumes frontier reasoning-model pricing remains broadly comparable to current premium API economics, with substantial discounts from batching and caching but added costs for long-context generation and repeated proof criticism.",
    "Search cost includes literature acquisition and indexing, citation-graph exploration, retrieval infrastructure, symbolic-computation workloads, small computational experiments, and storage.",
    "Verification cost includes isolated proof reconstruction, adversarial lemma checking, dependency auditing, theorem-prover work, computational replication, and manuscript-level consistency review.",
    "No governance charge is included because this is a non-governed lane; ordinary publication verification remains included.",
    "Elapsed hours are aggregate serial-equivalent research hours. Parallel execution could reduce calendar time, but coordination limits and sequential proof dependencies prevent proportional speedup.",
    "The reproduction probability concerns reconstructing a correct proof after relevant published material is available to the system. The independent-result probability concerns reaching a valid matching result without using the published proof's central argument.",
    "Success probability is lower than the reproduction probability because publication readiness also requires novelty or an acceptable independent reconstruction, complete exposition, verification, and resolution of reviewer-level objections.",
    "Costs do not include human mathematician labor except for limited operational review; adding sustained expert collaboration would materially change both cost and probability."
  ],
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "Whether the target follows from an identifiable existing proof architecture or requires genuinely new lower-bound techniques",
    "Model ability to maintain global consistency across long chains of algebraic-complexity lemmas",
    "Availability and quality of machine-readable literature, notation normalization, and citation metadata",
    "Rate at which plausible but subtly false structural lemmas survive automated critic passes",
    "Suitability of current proof assistants and algebra libraries for formalizing arithmetic-circuit arguments",
    "Need for new combinatorial, geometric, rank-based, or random-restriction machinery not represented clearly in training data",
    "API pricing, context-window limits, inference reliability, and tool-call latency",
    "Effectiveness of branch diversity and whether parallel agents converge prematurely on the same failed strategy",
    "Publication novelty standards and the possibility that a correct reconstruction is not independently publishable",
    "Difficulty of verifying asymptotic parameters, field assumptions, circuit models, uniformity conditions, and hidden characteristic restrictions"
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A precise theorem specifying the arithmetic circuit or formula model, base field and characteristic assumptions, size measure, degree restrictions, and the claimed n^4/log n lower-bound regime",
    "A complete proof with every reduction and parameter choice stated explicitly",
    "Independent reconstruction of the proof by agents isolated from the primary derivation trace",
    "Adversarial checks for model mismatch, characteristic dependence, nonuniformity, degree blowup, and asymptotic edge cases",
    "Machine-checked formalization of the most fragile core lemmas, or equivalently strong dual independent verification where full formalization is impractical",
    "Reproducible code and archived outputs for every computational experiment used as evidence",
    "A literature and novelty audit demonstrating how the result differs from known lower bounds and proof methods",
    "A replication package containing definitions, dependency graphs, proof versions, critic reports, experiment scripts, and a submission-ready manuscript",
    "At least two independent end-to-end verification passes that agree on the theorem statement and detect no unresolved major gap"
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "The target may require a conceptual breakthrough outside the reliable extrapolation capabilities of current autonomous models.",
    "Automated systems may repeatedly generate convincing but invalid lower-bound arguments that implicitly change the circuit model or overstate a rank or dimension bound.",
    "Full formalization may be obstructed by inadequate libraries for algebraic complexity, forcing expensive manual reconstruction.",
    "Literature contamination can make independent rediscovery difficult to establish even when the produced argument appears novel.",
    "A reproduced known proof may satisfy technical correctness but fail the novelty threshold for publication.",
    "Long-horizon autonomous execution may suffer context drift, duplicated branches, citation errors, and loss of crucial negative results without stronger governance infrastructure.",
    "No claimed feasibility is implied by these estimates; the low confidence and probabilities reflect the frontier and potentially breakthrough-level nature of the objective."
  ]
}
